title.narrative: CCASE_Non-Economic loss and damage & small-scale adaptation due to Climate Change_AVAS

description.narrative: The project has two components- a) Understanding of what is non-economic loss and damage and how non-economic losses and damages can be addressed, which is important as climate-vulnerable countries and marginalised people in those countries disproportionately depend on non-economic goods and services. Moreover, the intangibility of many non-economic losses and damages complicates how they are addressed. b) Supporting some of the non-economic loss and damage in a climate displacement project, supported by BRAC-KfW (German Bank). The project expects to change locally and nationally by providing authoritative assessment and presentation of evidence based on loss and damage that can reach diverse audiences, including academicians, policymakers, and the general public, through accessible findings/ assessments—closing the knowledge gap/ developing products to assist people affected by non-economic loss and damage. The project plans to include policy and advocacy by developing knowledge that can be used to inform decision-making and financing and create a better understanding of the range of impacts of climate shocks. The project will help to address some of the gaps in the Christian Aid Climate Displacement Fund such as access to toilets, livelihood activities, etc. Directly-15000 persons (approximately 49% women; 1 % people with disability) (community resilience component). TBD- research component. In-directly- TBD (will be calculated during the inception once the research project area is identified).
